rule: Brief (evidence lane, 2026-10-10): TRAIN-ONLY rows for the 10 JevBench families with no jev1 rows, ~6,000 per family (60k over 10), from public TRAIN splits or deterministic generators only; no rate or count taken from JevBench items or any eval row. Stage a = multi_hop, judge_hard, temporal_numeric, fact, tool_selection; stage b = probability, trap, ambiguous, tradeoff, adversarial. Within a family, sub-source shares come from data.jev2.PLAN (fixed before any gate ran; generated with ~35% headroom over the target for gate drops); the final trim is sha256(id) order (label-blind). Label rates are the natural train-split rates for public rows and the generator's own rule outcomes for synthetic rows (reported, never tuned toward any eval rate). Question-type mix per family follows the family's public FORMAT (type counts of the public items are format, not labels). Option presentation order is a seeded per-row shuffle. A family short of T after the gates is reported short, never topped up from another family.

musique.selection: sha256('jev2-part|musique:<id>') % 5 == 0, supporting paragraphs <= 3,200 chars, first n in file order

gsm8k.pools: sha256('jev2-part|gsm8k:<i>') % 2: 0 judge_hard, 1 temporal_numeric (no problem in two families)

glaive_fc.selection: hash % 6 == 0; first user turn <= 240 chars whose first assistant turn calls a listed function

not_used.HotpotQA / 2WikiMultihopQA: HotpotQA underlies HoVer (an Index benchmark); MuSiQue covers the family (its paragraphs still pass the Index guards per row)
not_used.NaturalQuestions / TriviaQA: fact rows are short explicit statements; BoolQ + generator cover it
not_used.ToolBench / APIGen / xLAM: licence / gating; Glaive FC v2 (Apache-2.0) is on disk
not_used.HelpSteer2 / UltraFeedback: HelpSteer2 is already used by jev1 adequacy; judge_hard uses GSM8K solutions + rule-checked synthetic responses
not_used.TimeQA / TempReason / FinQA: deterministic rule engines give exact gold
